mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5% (Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE increases by >0.5pp over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1350.0) and retail sales (RSAFS < 720000.0) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 5.0% periods, rising FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative SPX 60-day returns in >60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) expansion indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0 (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1300.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction that reduces consumer confidence and retail activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 1300.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS < 159000) indicates unexpected economic weakness that reduces consumer spending power, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE < 3.5% periods, PAYEMS declines fail to predict negative SPX 60-day returns in >60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL (inflation) increases above 5.0% and retail sales (RSAFS) declines below 720000.0 indicate stagflationary pressures that reduce corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of CPIAUCSL rising and RSAFS falling fails to predict negative SPX returns in >60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window).
